title: Nectar de baobab (Baobab Fruit Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: A kilogram of baobab pulp soaked 10 minutes, macerated, filtered and boiled 20 minutes in 5 litres of water to rid it of micro-organisms, then sugar, milk or flavouring added and the drink bottled and kept cool.
longDesc: p. 76 of the October 2023 recipe book: 1 kg of baobab pulp, 120 g of sugar, flavouring or milk (as chosen), 5 litres of water and an optional preservative. The fruit is sorted, soaked 10 minutes, macerated and filtered; the filtered juice is boiled 20 minutes ‘to rid it of all micro-organisms’, cooled, mixed with the sugar, milk or flavouring and preservative, bottled and kept cool. The diagram shows 65 degrees and 12% sugar; text and diagram disagree and are not reconciled. No shelf life is printed.
ingredients: Flavouring or milk, as chosen — quantity not printed
steps: Sort the fruit. Soak it 10 minutes.
Cool. Mix in the sugar, milk or flavouring and the optional preservative.
chefTips: The book’s stated aim of the 20-minute boil is to rid the juice of micro-organisms.
The diagram shows 65 degrees and 12% sugar; the text says 20 minutes of boiling. Not reconciled.
Keep cool; no shelf life is printed.
commonMistakes: Assuming a shelf life that the book does not give.
storage: Keep cool (‘conserver au frais’). No shelf life is printed.
healthBenefits: Baobab pulp is a tart fruit; the drink is sweetened.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe. The ingredient list says pulp while the method begins from whole fruit.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar de baobab’ (p. 76). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 20 is a placeholder. TWO-PASS.

CONFLICTS (unreconciled): list says pulp, method says fruit; the diagram shows ‘Cuisson (65°)’ and ‘Sucre (12%)’ against 20 minutes of boiling in the text. ABSENT: flavouring, milk and preservative quantities; shelf life.
